resources.string: A Genesis Node card\'s live status: green running, red not running, yellow being slashed, gray cooling down.
Which Genesis Node card should this widget show?
Enter a card number from 1 to 2500

Add a widget: long-press an empty spot on your home screen → Widgets → Delphi Nodes → drag \"Delphi Node\" onto the screen, then enter the card number. Add one widget per card.\n\nColors: green running · red not running or not staked · yellow being slashed · gray cooling down. Widgets refresh about every 15 minutes; tap one to open its card.
